subject: storytime
title: Owl Diaries words
about: Eva is a young owl who keeps a diary, and when she plans a big spring festival for her school she takes on far more jobs than one owl can manage. This level teaches the words the child will meet in the book, so the library copy is easier to read on his own.
tip: Borrow the book from the library after the level and read it together, a diary entry or two each night.

book.author: Rebecca Elliott
book.source: a library favorite; this level teaches its words, the app does not contain the book
book.blurb: A busy little owl learns that a festival is more fun when friends share the work.
